/-! ## §3. Global generation as a statement about sections

`evalMap_surjective` is the sharp form, but it is phrased on a subquotient.  The form a
consumer wants is about an actual rational function: *some global section of `𝒪(D)`
attains the pole bound at `P`*.  That is `GeneratedAt` below, and it follows from
surjectivity together with the nontriviality of `κ(P)` (`1 ≤ [κ(P):k]`).
-/

section GeneratedAt

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)

/-- **`𝒪(D)` is generated by global sections at `P`.**  Some global section attains the
pole bound at `P` exactly: `ord_P f = -D(P)`.

Such an `f` generates the stalk `𝒪(D)_P` over `𝒪_P`, since any two elements of the
fractional ideal `𝔪_P^{-D(P)}` of minimal order differ by a unit.  Stated on the order
rather than on the stalk so that it is checkable in the adelic language; a section with
`ord_P f > -D(P)` is exactly one that *fails* to generate, i.e. vanishes at `P` as a
section of the twist. -/
def GeneratedAt (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : X.functionField, f ∈ sectionSub k ⊤ D ∧ f ≠ 0 ∧
    Scheme.RationalMap.order P f = -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P

/-- **Surjectivity of the evaluation map gives global generation at `P`.**

`κ(P)` is nontrivial (`1 ≤ [κ(P):k]`, `one_le_residueDeg`), so the target of `evalMap`
has a nonzero element; a preimage of it is a global section `f` of `𝒪(D)` whose class in
`orderGe P (-D(P)) / orderGe P (-D(P)+1)` is nonzero, i.e. with
`ord_P f < -D(P) + 1`.  Being a section of `𝒪(D)` gives the reverse `ord_P f ≥ -D(P)`,
so `ord_P f = -D(P)`. -/
theorem generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (evalMap k D P))
    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
    GeneratedAt k D P := by
  -- the target is nontrivial: its dimension is `[κ(P):k] ≥ 1`
  haveI : Nontrivial
      (localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)) := by
    refine Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := k) ?_
    rw [finrank_localStepTgt]
    exact one_le_residueDeg k P
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 :
    localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P))
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hsurj z
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  refine ⟨(f : X.functionField), f.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- a section whose class is nonzero cannot be `0`
    intro hf0
    apply hz
    rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply]
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub, hf0]
    exact (orderGe _ _).zero_mem
  · -- the two inequalities
    have hlow : -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P ≤
        Scheme.RationalMap.order P (f : X.functionField) := by
      rcases eq_or_ne (f : X.functionField) 0 with hf0 | hf0
      · exact absurd hf0 (by
          intro h
          apply hz
          rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply,
            Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
            Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub, h]
          exact (orderGe _ _).zero_mem)
      exact (mem_sectionOfDivisor_of_ne_zero hf0).mp f.2 P
        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top P.point)
    have hhigh : Scheme.RationalMap.order P (f : X.functionField) <
        -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P + 1 := by
      by_contra hge
      apply hz
      rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
        Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub]
      refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [sub_pointDivisor_apply_self]
      omega
    omega

composed with `generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective`. -/
theorem generatedAt_of_vanishing
    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
    (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
    (hD : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D))
    (hDP : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ (D - pointDivisor P)))
    [Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
    GeneratedAt k D P :=
  generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective k D P
    (evalMap_surjective k U₀ U₁ hledger D P hD hDP)

/-! ## §4. The threshold: how far above the vanishing bound

`generatedAt_of_vanishing` needs vanishing at `D` *and* at `D − P`.  Feeding it the
bounded-vanishing theorem requires both divisors above the threshold `b`, and

`deg_k (D − P) = deg_k D − [κ(P):k]`,

so the generation threshold is `b + [κ(P):k]` — the vanishing bound raised by the
residue degree **at that point**.  Two forms follow.

*Pointwise* (`generatedAt_of_bound`): for each `P` separately, no extra hypothesis.

*Uniform* (`forall_generatedAt_of_bound_of_residueDeg_le`): the same `D` generating at
**every** `P` at once needs a uniform bound `r` on residue degrees, `∀ P, [κ(P):k] ≤ r`.
That is a real hypothesis and not a formality: over a finite field the residue degrees
of closed points are unbounded, so no such `r` exists there, whereas over an
algebraically closed base `r = 1` works.  This is the precise sense in which global
generation is "the bound raised by the maximum residue degree" — and the maximum has to
exist.
-/

section Threshold

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)

/-- **Global generation above the shifted bound, pointwise in `P`.**

Given the three inputs of `exists_bound_subsingleton_h1Mod` there is a threshold `b`
such that for every `P` and every `D` with `deg_k D ≥ b + [κ(P):k]`, the sheaf `𝒪(D)`
is generated by global sections at `P`.

The shift by `[κ(P):k]` is exactly what puts `D − P` above `b` as well; it is not
slack. -/
theorem exists_bound_generatedAt
    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
    (D₀ : X.WeilDivisor) (hbase : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D₀))
    (hpeel : ∀ D' : X.WeilDivisor,
      (∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D₀) P ≤
        (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D') P) →
      Peel k U₀ U₁ D₀ D')
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor),
      b + residueDeg k P ≤ degK k D → GeneratedAt k D P := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    exists_bound_subsingleton_h1Mod k U₀ U₁ hledger D₀ hbase hpeel
  refine ⟨b, fun D P hD => ?_⟩
  have hdegDP : degK k (D - pointDivisor P) = degK k D - residueDeg k P := by
    rw [degK_sub, degK_pointDivisor]
  refine generatedAt_of_vanishing k U₀ U₁ hledger D P (hb D (by omega)) ?_
  exact hb (D - pointDivisor P) (by omega)

residue degrees, one threshold `b + r` works for **every** point at once: above it,

module docstring). -/

    (r : ℕ) (hr : ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, residueDeg k P ≤ r)
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, b ≤ degK k D →
      ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, GeneratedAt k D P := by
